d:
Chhath par banaie thekuaa stail pipe vale biskit
Bina maida, bina ovan – gehun, suji aur ghi se, karhaee men!
Masala Kitchen men Poonam Devnani ki aaj ki resipi: pipe vale biskita. sabut chini ki trik, nariyal-saunph-ilaychi ka svad aur ghi ka moyna. ek bar banakar rakh lijie, purane zamane ki tarah mahine bhar chalte hain.
thekuaa stail pipe vale biskit ki puri resipi
sabut chini ko bina ghole istemal karne ki trik
karhaee men dhimi aanch par talne ka tarika, bek karne ka vikalp bhi
bina maida, bina ovan, bina dalda
Kament men bataie – aapke yahan inhen pipe vale biskit kahte hain ya thekuaa?
